❯ /model

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Select model
  Switch between Claude models. Your pick becomes the default for new sessions. For other/previous model names, specify with --model.

  ❯ 1. Default (recommended) ✔  Use the default model (currently Opus 5.5 (1M context)) · $4/$20 per Mtok
    2. Opus (1M context)        Opus 5.5 with 1M context · Best for everyday, complex tasks · $4/$20 per Mtok
    3. Fable                    Fable 5.1 · Most capable for your hardest and longest-running tasks · $10/$50 per Mtok
    4. Sonnet                   Sonnet 5 · Efficient for routine tasks · $2/$10 per Mtok
    5. Haiku                    Haiku 4.5 · Fastest for quick answers · $1/$5 per Mtok

  ◈ Max effort ←/→ to adjust
  May use excessive tokens resulting in long response times or overthinking. Use sparingly for the hardest tasks.

  Enter to set as default · s to use this session only · Esc to cancel
